Title: AI-Based Smart Water Leakage Detection and Pipeline Monitoring System
Description: Develop an intelligent water pipeline monitoring system that detects leaks in real time using pressure sensors, acoustic sensors, and edge AI. The system uses a Raspberry Pi with a machine learning model to analyze pressure variations and vibration patterns, accurately identifying leakage locations. IoT connectivity sends instant alerts to a mobile dashboard, while GPS-based mapping helps maintenance teams locate damaged pipeline sections. The solution aims to reduce water loss, enable predictive maintenance, and improve the efficiency of municipal water distribution networks.

concept_enhancement.invention_title: AI-Based Smart Waste Segregation System for Urban Recycling
concept_enhancement.invention_description: An intelligent waste segregation system that automatically identifies and separates biodegradable, recyclable, and hazardous waste using computer vision and artificial intelligence. The system uses a camera, weight sensors, and proximity sensors to analyze incoming waste, classify it in real time, and direct it into the appropriate collection bin through an automated mechanical sorting mechanism. It also includes an IoT module that monitors bin capacity, sends alerts when bins are full, and provides waste collection analytics to municipal authorities through a mobile dashboard.

core_principle: The system operates through an integrated electro-mechanical pipeline combining multi-spectral visual capture, weight-based volumetric profiling, and automated robotic or pneumatic diversion.

Inbound material enters an isolated inspection bay where high-speed imaging sensors extract surface contour and texture data. On-device edge neural models execute real-time classification across biodegradable, recyclable, and hazardous categories in sub-50ms cycles.

Deterministic control logic coordinates servo-driven deflectors to guide sorted items into designated receptacles, while load transducers monitor bin capacity and trigger compaction or emptying alerts.

key_modules.purpose: Multi-class waste item detection and classification.
Correlates visual bounding boxes with mass density from load cells.
Executes quantized neural inference locally without latency.
Actuates servo diverters and pneumatic flaps for physical separation.
Tracks fill levels and transmits operational metrics to municipal dashboards.

technical_differentiators: Dual-stage classification combining visual geometry with mass-to-volume ratio to resolve ambiguous packaging.
Edge-native inference pipeline delivering consistent sub-50ms mechanical gating independent of cloud backhaul.
Self-clearing anti-jam mechanical diverters equipped with current-sensing stall protection.
Continuous automated calibration compensating for ambient illumination and dust accumulation.

system_architecture.system_flow: Material passes through an optical scanning chamber where visual and weight sensors stream data to an edge processor. The processor infers material classification and pulses high-speed servo actuators, while operational metrics sync to an administrative dashboard.

retrieved_patents.claims: 1. A quantum processing system comprising: a cryostat housing superconducting qubits; and a cryogenic control circuit generating microwave excitation pulses.

retrieved_patents.title: Autonomous Vehicle Trajectory Planning via Dynamic Occupancy Grid Neural Networks
retrieved_patents.abstract: A trajectory planning system for autonomous land vehicles combining LiDAR point cloud segmentation with dynamic occupancy grid probability maps to compute collision-free navigation vectors in high-density traffic.
retrieved_patents.claims: 1. A vehicle trajectory planning apparatus comprising: a LiDAR sensor array; a deep reinforcement learning processor generating spatial probability maps; and a steering controller.
